faq.title: Everything you need to feel certain.
faq.description: Still wondering about a product or payment method? A real support specialist is always close.

items.question: How quickly will my order arrive?
items.answer: Automatic products usually arrive in seconds. Every product shows an honest delivery estimate before checkout, and manual services include a visible SLA.

items.question: Which payment methods can I use in Lebanon?
items.answer: You can use Nexora Wallet, Whish Money, OMT, Visa or Mastercard, supported crypto networks, bank transfer, and approved cash flows.

items.question: What happens if delivery fails?
items.answer: Our hybrid fulfillment automatically moves eligible failures to a staffed queue. If delivery cannot be completed, the order follows its protected refund policy.

items.question: Are gift-card codes and accounts guaranteed?
items.answer: Warranty terms are shown per product and variant. Verified codes are atomically assigned from private inventory and cannot be delivered twice.

items.question: Can I sell through Nexora?
items.answer: Yes. Resellers receive wholesale tiers, a dedicated dashboard, signed API access, sandbox mode, and delivery webhooks.

scope.title: Scope
scope.body: This policy covers Nexora accounts, storefront, reseller API, support, payments, and notifications.

data.title: Data we process
data.body: We process identity, device, order, payment-reference, support, fraud-prevention, and preference data only for stated purposes. Card details stay with the payment processor.

payments.title: Security and sharing
payments.body: We share the minimum required data with payment, delivery, communications, fraud, and infrastructure processors under contractual safeguards.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You may access, correct, export, object to marketing, withdraw consent, or request deletion from the privacy center. Legal and financial retention duties may delay deletion.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Contact privacy@nexora.example for privacy requests or complaints.

scope.title: Agreement
scope.body: By using Nexora you agree to these terms, product-specific instructions, acceptable-use rules, and applicable law.

data.title: Accounts
data.body: Keep credentials secure, provide accurate delivery inputs, and do not use the platform for fraud, abuse, resale without authorization, or unlawful activity.

payments.title: Orders and payments
payments.body: Prices, fees, currency, delivery mode, warranty, and restrictions are shown before confirmation. Digital delivery can begin immediately after payment.

rights.title: Availability and liability
rights.body: We use reasonable safeguards and failover, but third-party networks and suppliers can be interrupted. Mandatory consumer rights remain unaffected.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Contact support@nexora.example for terms or order questions.

scope.title: Eligibility
scope.body: Failed, undelivered, materially incorrect, or warranty-covered digital goods may qualify after verification.

data.title: Non-refundable cases
data.body: Correctly delivered and revealed codes, completed services, user-input errors, consumed top-ups, and policy-abusing orders are generally non-refundable unless law requires otherwise.

payments.title: How refunds are paid
payments.body: Approved refunds return to the wallet or original method when supported. Provider and blockchain fees may be non-refundable when disclosed before payment.

rights.title: Disputes
rights.body: Open a request from the order page with evidence. We preserve order events and provide a reasoned decision; chargebacks can place the account and funds on hold.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Contact refunds@nexora.example or use order support.
